description:
Update workspace-level documentation to reflect the new `jmap-jscalendar-types` crate after the code extraction (children .1 and .2) has landed.

## Files to update

1. **Workspace root `AGENTS.md`** — three sections need edits:

   - **Crate Map table** (top of file): add a row for `crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/` / `jmap-jscalendar-types`. Suggested description: "RFC 8984 JSCalendar typed sub-types — shared foundation, consumed by Calendars and Tasks. No async, no JMAP dep."
   - **Dependency Tree** ASCII diagram: insert `jmap-jscalendar-types` as a sibling foundation crate (alongside `jmap-types`), with edges into `jmap-calendars-types` and (after JMAP-yfpq lands) `jmap-tasks-types`. The diagram already shows `jmap-types` at the root; the new crate is structurally similar — no JMAP dep, consumed by extension-types crates.
   - **Canonical Templates table**: do NOT add this crate. It is foundation-shaped (like `jmap-types`), not a member of the extension-types cookie-cutter family. The table's purpose is to show propagation paths within a sibling family; the new crate has no siblings.

2. **Workspace root `README.md`** (if it lists crates): mirror the change to the Crate Map. Check first whether the workspace README has a crate listing — if not, this step is a no-op.

3. **`crate-jmap-calendars-types/README.md`**: the current type table includes references to JSCalendar sub-types (Location, RecurrenceRule, etc.) with "[RFC 8984 §X]" citations. Add a one-line note near that section: "These typed sub-types live in the `jmap-jscalendar-types` crate and are re-exported here for backward-compatible access."

## Acceptance

- Workspace AGENTS.md crate-map table has the new row.
- Dep-tree diagram in AGENTS.md is updated.
- No file claims the new crate is a canonical-template member of the extension-types family.
- Workspace README (if applicable) and calendars-types README are aligned.
- All Markdown is valid; no broken links.
- `cargo check --workspace` still clean (this child is doc-only).

## Coordination

This child can run in parallel with .2, but is cleanest landed after .2 so the docs describe an actually-existing state of the code. If landed in parallel, double-check that the AGENTS.md description matches what .2 actually shipped (esp. whether the `pub use jmap_jscalendar_types as jscalendar;` module alias was added per the .2 risk note).
title: Update workspace AGENTS.md / dep-tree / calendars-types README for jmap-jscalendar-types extraction
